components.css: .ds-button { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:44px; gap:8px; padding:10px 17px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:8px; font-family:"Segoe UI", system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size:.875rem; font-weight:600; line-height:1.5; cursor:pointer; text-decoration:none; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--accent,#2858c8); outline-offset:4px; } .ds-button:disabled { opacity:.6; cursor:wait; } .ds-task {display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:18px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line,#d8e1eb);font-family:"Segoe UI", system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;color:var(--ink,#172c43);} .ds-status {display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-shrink:0;width:44px;height:44px;padding:0;border:0;border-radius:8px;background:transparent;color:#647a93;cursor:pointer;} .ds-status:hover {color:var(--accent,#2858c8);background:#edf3ff;} .ds-status:focus-visible {outline:3px solid var(--accent,#2858c8);outline-offset:4px;} .ds-content {flex:1;min-width:0;} .ds-title {display:block;overflow-wrap:anywhere;font-size:1rem;line-height:1.5;} .ds-state {display:block;margin-top:3px;font-size:.75rem;line-height:1.5;color:var(--muted,#53657a);} .ds-actions {display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;flex-shrink:0;} .ds-actions .ds-button {padding-inline:12px;} .ds-quiet {color:var(--muted,#53657a);background:transparent;} .ds-quiet:hover {color:var(--ink,#172c43);background:#e8eef5;} .ds-delete {color:var(--danger,#a12838);background:transparent;} .ds-delete:hover {background:var(--danger-surface,#fff0f2);} @media(max-width:440px){.ds-task {flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;} .ds-content {flex-basis:calc(100% - 52px);} .ds-actions {padding-left:52px;width:100%;gap:16px;} .ds-actions .ds-button {padding-inline:10px;}}

narrative.overview:
The Campus Study Folio gives a private task list the feel of a working sheet: cool white surfaces, navy cover material and familiar controls. Its Operate mode uses system UI lettering, direct labels and enough room to act comfortably.

The system stays flat and practical. Ruled rows organize tasks; blue identifies primary actions; completion and errors have both words and color. Authentication pairs a blue introduction with a white form, while editing and recovery remain within the sheet.
keyCharacteristics: Cool white working sheets against a pale blue-gray ground.
System UI typography and restrained rounded rectangles.
Ruled task rows with explicit Open and Done labels.
Inline editing, clear recovery and visible keyboard focus.

rules.name: The Working Sheet Rule
rules.body: Keep related task controls within one ruled white sheet.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Use borders and color separation for depth; the shipped system has no shadows.

rules.name: The Visible State Rule
rules.body: Pair status color with a readable state label; done titles also receive a strike-through.

dos: Do preserve visible focus, field labels and inline validation.
Do let long task titles wrap and keep task actions reachable on narrow screens.
Do retain the minimum control sizes and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don't replace the approved working sheet with dashboard cards.
Don't add imagery or decorative display typography to this Operate interface.
Don't communicate completion or validation through color alone.
